newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Tranzrail upgrades NZ forklift fleet.
newsitem.headline: Tranzrail upgrades NZ forklift fleet.

text.p: New Zealand's railway, ferry and through transport operator Tranz Rail Holdings said on Tuesday it had agreed to buy 21 forklift trucks to update its cargo handling abilities in New Zealand.
The company said in a statement the new equipment was needed as it increased the capacity of its rail freight wagons.
The Kalmar LMV trucks will cater for heavy 20 and 40 foot ocean containers as well as refrigerated maxicube units.
"This purchase will upgrade our freight handling capabilities to cope with the increasing volume of freight traffic through our Tranz Link Distribution Branches," the company added.
